description:
Check whether a relation would be admissible before writing it. Reads the SAME relation-group
rule table create_relation and bulk_create validate against, so the answer matches what a write
would do.

Pass relationGroupId plus fromNodeId and toNodeId — both must already exist in the project.
Returns admissible, the rule (relation group label) it was checked against, a reason when
refused (naming the allowed direction), and alternative relation groups that do admit this
node-type pair.

Mixin form: instead of the relation arguments, pass mixinId, targetNodeId and mixinColumns (the same
items bulk_create takes under mixins; id = column ID, label = value). The answer comes from the same
dry-run checks bulk_create runs for mixin values, with nothing written: admissible, and the reason when
refused. Do not pass both forms in one call.
name: check_admissible
title: Check Admissible
